articles.title_en: Risk aversion and flexibility options in electricity markets
articles.title_cn: 电力市场中的风险规避与灵活性选项
articles.abstract_en: Flexibility options, such as demand response, energy storage and interconnection, have the potential to reduce variation in electricity prices between different future scenarios, thereby reducing investment risk. Investing in flexibility options can also lower the need for generation capacity. However, there are complex interactions between different flexibility options. In this paper, we investigate the interactions between flexibility and investment risk in electricity markets. In particular, we focus on the investment strategies of risk-averse decision-makers. We employ a large-scale stochastic transmission and generation expansion model of the European electricity system, providing it with uncertain future scenarios based on ENTSOs’ Ten-Year Network Development Plan. Using this model, we first investigate the effect of risk aversion on investment decisions. We find that the interplay of parameters leads to (i) more investment in a less emission-intensive energy system if planners are risk averse (hedging against CO2 price uncertainty), (ii) constant total installed capacity, regardless of the level of risk aversion (i.e. planners do not hedge against demand and uncertainties when deploying renewable energy sources) and (iii) an allocation of investments that disregards cost differences for load shedding across Europe. Second, we examine the individual effects of three flexibility elements on optimal investment levels at different levels of risk aversion: demand response, investment in additional interconnection capacity and investment in additional energy storage. We show that flexible technologies have a higher value for risk-averse decision-makers, although the effects are nonlinear. Finally, we investigate the interactions between the flexibility elements. We find that risk-averse decision-makers show a strong preference for transmission-grid expansion once flexibility is available at a low cost.
articles.abstract_cn: 灵活性选项，如需求响应、储能和互联，有潜力减少不同未来情景之间电力价格的波动，从而降低投资风险。投资于灵活性选项还可以降低对发电容量的需求。然而，不同灵活性选项之间存在复杂的相互作用。在本文中，我们研究了电力市场中灵活性与投资风险之间的相互作用。特别是，我们关注风险规避决策者的投资策略。我们采用了一个欧洲电力系统的大规模随机输电和发电扩展模型，并为其提供了基于ENTSOs十年网络发展计划的不确定未来情景。利用该模型，我们首先研究了风险规避对投资决策的影响。我们发现，参数的相互作用导致：（i）如果规划者风险规避（对冲二氧化碳价格不确定性），则会更多投资于低排放强度的能源系统；（ii）总装机容量保持不变，无论风险规避水平如何（即规划者在部署可再生能源时不对需求和不确定性进行对冲）；（iii）投资分配不考虑欧洲各地停电成本的差异。其次，我们考察了三个灵活性要素在不同风险规避水平下对最优投资水平的个体影响：需求响应、额外互联容量投资和额外储能投资。我们表明，灵活技术对风险规避决策者具有更高的价值，尽管影响是非线性的。最后，我们研究了灵活性要素之间的相互作用。我们发现，一旦灵活性以低成本可用，风险规避决策者表现出对输电网络扩展的强烈偏好。

articles.title_en: Time-varying tail risk connectedness among sustainability-related products and fossil energy investments
articles.title_cn: 可持续相关产品与化石能源投资间的时变尾部风险溢出
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we analyse the dynamic transmission of tail risk across a set of well-established sustainability-related financial indices & equities and energy assets using a novel CAViaR-TVP-VAR connectedness measure on daily data from 14 October 2014 to 31 August 2022. Findings suggest that the total risk connectedness is at medium level and the short-run effect of COVID-19 on the risk transmission was mild. Furthermore, ESG and green equities are persistent net risk transmitters, while green bond, carbon asset, and energy commodities are tail risk takers. The role of renewable energy stocks is inconclusive due to distinct time-varying characteristics. With reference to pairwise relationship, we show that sustainability equities strongly interact with crude oil futures and fossil energy equities. Furthermore, green bond, carbon, natural gas and coal futures weakly associate with the remaining assets in the system. Finally, we find that EPU, OVX, VIX, GPR, and the spread of US Treasury have asymmetric impact on the spillovers. Altogether, our results offer insightful implications for policymakers and especially for “green” and “brown” products investors in risk diversification from the VaR perspective.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文使用新颖的CAViaR-TVP-VAR溢出度量方法，基于2014年十月14日至2022年八月31日的日度数据，分析了一系列成熟的可持续相关金融指数与股票以及能源资产之间尾部风险的动态传导。研究发现，总风险溢出处于中等水平，COVID-19对风险传导的短期影响较为温和。此外，ESG和绿色股票是持续的风险净传递者，而绿色债券、碳资产和能源商品是尾部风险的接受者。可再生能源股票的作用因时变特征不同而不确定。就配对关系而言，我们表明可持续股票与原油期货和化石能源股票有较强的相互作用。此外，绿色债券、碳、天然气和煤炭期货与系统中的其余资产关联较弱。最后，我们发现EPU、OVX、VIX、GPR以及美国国债利差对溢出具有不对称影响。总体而言，我们的结果为政策制定者，尤其是从VaR角度进行风险分散的“绿色”和“棕色”产品投资者提供了有见地的启示。

articles.title_en: Transitioning to a greener labor market: Cross-country evidence from microdata
articles.title_cn: 迈向更绿色的劳动力市场：来自微观数据的跨国证据
articles.abstract_en: To better understand the potential consequences of the green economic transformation and green policies for workers, we construct and analyze a new set of harmonized indicators of the environmental properties of jobs using micro-level labor force survey data for a large cross-country sample of 31 countries over 2005–19. We find that greener and more polluting jobs are concentrated among small subsets of workers, individual workers rarely move from more pollution-intensive to greener jobs, and workers in green-intensive jobs earn on average 7% more than workers in pollution-intensive jobs. Stronger environmental policies are associated with a higher (lower) share of green-(pollution-)intensive jobs and appear to be even more effective when structural policies that incentivize greater flexibility in labor markets are operating. Taken together, the evidence suggests that with the right policies, the green transition for the labor market is manageable but will be tough for some workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了更好地理解绿色经济转型和绿色政策对工人的潜在影响，我们利用大型跨国样本（涵盖31个国家，时间跨度为2005-19年）的微观劳动力调查数据，构建并分析了一套新的关于工作环境属性的统一指标。我们发现，更绿色和污染更严重的工作集中在少数工人群体中，个体工人很少从污染密集型工作转向更绿色的工作，且绿色密集型工作的工人平均收入比污染密集型工作的工人高7%。更强的环境政策与更高（更低）的绿色（污染）密集型工作份额相关，并且在激励劳动力市场更大灵活性的结构性政策发挥作用时，这些环境政策似乎更为有效。总体来看，证据表明，在正确的政策下，劳动力市场的绿色转型是可以管理的，但对某些工人来说将是艰难的。

articles.title_en: Identifying money and inflation expectation shocks to real oil prices
articles.title_cn: 识别实际油价中的货币与通胀预期冲击
articles.abstract_en: The paper extends the well-known three-variable SVAR model that explains real oil prices based on supply and demand shocks to the oil market. We identify significant monetary sources of shocks to real oil prices through a money supply shock and an inflation expectations shock. Results indicate robust significance of these two monetary shocks under a variety of time periods, using an alternate aggregate demand variable, and adding a fourth fundamental variable based on oil inventories. We also use alternative money aggregates for the money supply. Given their significance, we derive a historical variance decomposition of real oil price changes by each shock's contribution. We find a significant displacement of oil supply and demand factors by monetary factors that we match up to historical US monetary policy regimes. During major oil price episodes when monetary shocks dominate, the US money supply and inflation expectation shocks largely explain oil price increases above fundamentals. We interpret this in terms of the US monetary policy during crisis periods and find a common component of that policy linked to oil price episodes. Results imply that US monetary policy led to unintended consequences in energy markets. The results could facilitate improvements in international energy policy, US monetary policy, and global economic stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文扩展了著名的三变量SVAR模型，该模型基于石油市场的供给和需求冲击来解释实际油价。我们通过货币供给冲击和通胀预期冲击，识别出实际油价中显著的货币来源冲击。结果表明，在不同的时间段内，使用替代的总需求变量，并添加基于石油库存的第四个基本面变量，这两种货币冲击均具有稳健的显著性。我们还使用了替代的货币总量来衡量货币供给。鉴于其显著性，我们通过各冲击的贡献推导出实际油价变动的历史方差分解。我们发现货币因素显著替代了石油供给和需求因素，并将其与历史上的美国货币政策体制相匹配。在货币冲击占主导地位的主要油价事件期间，美国货币供给和通胀预期冲击在很大程度上解释了高于基本面的油价上涨。我们将其解释为危机时期美国的货币政策，并发现该政策与油价事件相关的共同成分。结果表明，美国货币政策导致了能源市场的意外后果。这些结果可能有助于改善国际能源政策、美国货币政策和全球经济稳定。

articles.title_en: Carbon abatement in the European chemical industry: assessing the feasibility of abatement technologies by estimating firm-level marginal abatement costs
articles.title_cn: 欧洲化学工业的碳减排：通过估算企业级边际减排成本评估减排技术的可行性
articles.abstract_en: As many other industries, the chemical industry has to strongly reduce its' carbon emissions, for which various abatement technologies exist. We study the economic feasibility of these abatement technologies by estimating the Marginal Abatement Cost (MAC) of CO2 emissions for 24 firms in the European chemical sector over the period 2015–2020. We estimate the firm-level MAC by using a quadratic directional output distance function (DDF) model. We find a median MAC of 429 €/t CO2, which is significantly above current carbon prices, indicating that most firms in this industry prefer to use carbon allowances instead of reducing their own emissions. We conclude that carbon abatement in the chemical industry is only likely when the carbon price is significantly higher or when financial support is provided for certain abatement technologies, such as renewable hydrogen and bio-based ammonia.
articles.abstract_cn: 与许多其他行业一样，化学工业必须大幅减少其碳排放，为此存在各种减排技术。我们通过估算2015-2020年期间欧洲化学行业24家企业的二氧化碳排放边际减排成本（MAC），来研究这些减排技术的经济可行性。我们使用二次方向性距离函数（DDF）模型估算企业级MAC。我们发现MAC的中位数为429欧元/吨二氧化碳，显著高于当前碳价格，表明该行业大多数企业更倾向于使用碳配额而非减少自身排放。我们得出结论，只有当碳价格显著提高或为某些减排技术（如可再生氢和生物基氨）提供财政支持时，化学工业的碳减排才可能实现。

articles.title_en: Oil news shocks and the U.S. stock market
articles.title_cn: 石油新闻冲击与美国股市
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of oil news shocks on U.S. aggregate and industry-level stock returns. Using a Proxy-VAR and a sample from January 1973 to December 2019, we find no significant effect on aggregate stock price index on impact, but a persistent and significant drop at longer horizons. An important degree of heterogeneity is found in the industry-level responses: stock returns for precious metals, coal, petroleum and natural gas, and utilities increase significantly and persistently after the shock, whereas consumer goods, rubber and plastic, automobiles, and trucks fall briefly. Moreover, our estimates indicate that oil news shocks pose a risk for IT sectors whose returns exhibit losses. When we extend the sample to December 2022, we uncover a crucial change in the dynamics of the oil surprise measure: it is contaminated by lags of the oil price. We illustrate how using the oil surprise as an instrumental variable in the extended sample produces puzzling responses of industry-level stock returns, whereas a purged measure of the oil surprise leads to more stable estimates.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了石油新闻冲击对美国总体和行业层面股票回报的影响。使用代理VAR和从1973年一月到2019年十二月的样本，我们发现对总体股票价格指数在冲击当期没有显著影响，但在更长的时间范围内有持续且显著的下降。在行业层面的反应中发现了重要的异质性：贵金属、煤炭、石油和天然气以及公用事业的股票回报在冲击后显著且持续增加，而消费品、橡胶和塑料、汽车和卡车则短暂下跌。此外，我们的估计表明，石油新闻冲击对信息技术行业构成风险，其回报出现损失。当我们将样本扩展到2022年十二月时，我们发现了石油意外度量动态的一个关键变化：它受到石油价格滞后项的污染。我们说明了在扩展样本中使用石油意外作为工具变量如何产生令人困惑的行业层面股票回报反应，而经过清理的石油意外度量则导致更稳定的估计。

articles.title_en: Green transformation in oligopoly markets under common ownership
articles.title_cn: 共同所有权下寡头市场的绿色转型
articles.abstract_en: This study conducts a theoretical investigation on how common ownership (or the extent of cooperation in an industry) affects firms’ incentives to adopt green sources in an oligopoly. The findings show that common ownership hinders the switch from brown to green sources in two ways. First, an increase in the degree of common ownership reduces a firm’s incentive to adopt green sources. Second, an increase in the degree of common ownership induces a production substitution from green to brown firms. Both these effects reduce the share of green sources.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究对共同所有权（或行业合作程度）如何影响寡头企业采用绿色能源的激励进行了理论探讨。研究结果表明，共同所有权通过两种方式阻碍从棕色能源向绿色能源的转变。第一，共同所有权程度的提高降低了企业采用绿色能源的激励。第二，共同所有权程度的提高导致生产从绿色企业向棕色企业替代。这两种效应都降低了绿色能源的份额。

articles.title_en: The co-movements among renewable energy, total environmental tax, and ecological footprint in the United Kingdom: Evidence from wavelet local multiple correlation analysis
articles.abstract_en: This study evaluates the efficacy of total environmental tax, economic growth and renewable energy in curbing ecological footprint in the United Kingdom for the period 1995Q1–2018Q4. As the first study to dynamically investigate the connection between these factors in the short and long term at various frequencies in a multivariate setting, we add to the literature by painting a clearer picture of the dynamics influencing ecological footprint. For this reason, we employ an innovative technique, namely the newly developed wavelet local multiple correlation (WLMC) approach, which can identify the connections between indicators at various periods and frequencies. The results from the WLMC disclose that total environmental tax, economic growth, and renewable energy curb ecological footprint. Furthermore, a significant positive connection is found between environmental tax, economic growth, and renewable energy in the short and long term. According to the findings, environmental taxes, renewable energy, and economic expansion are useful tools for increasing environmental quality in the United Kingdom. The research's findings offer important recommendations for developing policies to aid the United Kingdom in achieving SDGs 7, 8, 12, and 13 while also preserving ecological sustainability.

articles.title_en: Strategies for reducing ethnic inequality in energy outcomes: A Nepalese example
articles.title_cn: 减少能源结果中民族不平等的策略：尼泊尔案例
articles.abstract_en: This paper assesses ethnic differences for four energy outcomes using a survey of 6000 households in Nepal. These four outcomes are avoiding open wick lamps, having a solar lighting system, living in a neighbourhood with street lighting, and having a connection to the national grid. We find large differences across ethnic groups, with the Madhesi group having distinct energy outcomes, for each of the four dimensions. However, progressively more detailed locational variables explain much of the difference. Our interactive analysis then suggests that some of the remaining variation is explained by socioeconomic variables of having a financial account, school attendance, or membership of a women's group. Promoting these potentially favourable socioeconomic outcomes could be useful strategies for also indirectly reducing ethnic inequality in energy outcomes and future energy policymaking. However, ethnic inequality for the most place-based outcome, being living in an area with street lighting, is not reduced by the key socioeconomic variables. The results are also robust after isolating ethnic differences from locational influences.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用对尼泊尔6000户家庭的调查，评估了四个能源结果方面的民族差异。这四个结果是避免使用明火油灯、拥有太阳能照明系统、居住在具有街道照明的社区，以及接入国家电网。我们发现不同民族群体之间存在巨大差异，其中马德西群体在四个维度上都有明显的能源结果。然而，逐渐更详细的位置变量解释了许多差异。我们的交互分析随后表明，剩余差异的一部分由社会经济变量解释，如拥有金融账户、上学或加入妇女团体。促进这些潜在有利的社会经济结果可能是间接减少能源结果中的民族不平等和未来能源政策制定的有用策略。然而，对于最基于位置的能源结果，即居住在具有街道照明的地区，关键社会经济变量并未减少民族不平等。在将民族差异与位置影响隔离后，结果也是稳健的。

articles.title_en: Sailing across climate-friendly bonds and clean energy stocks: An asymmetric analysis with the Gulf Cooperation Council Stock markets
articles.title_cn: 跨越气候友好债券与清洁能源股票：与海湾合作委员会股票市场的非对称分析
articles.abstract_en: This study endeavors to identify the extreme quantile dependence between clean energy stocks and climate-friendly (or green) bonds with GCC stock markets for the period encompassing September 1, 2014 to September 17, 2021. Employing the cross-quantilogram technique, we report higher dependencies between clean energy stocks and the stocks of United Arab Emirates, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia, whereas moderate to lower dependencies exist between clean energy stocks and the stocks of Bahrain, Kuwait, and Oman. Climate-friendly bonds reveal an insignificant correlation with all GCC stocks except the UAE, indicating the diversification benefits of these climate-friendly bonds for GCC stock markets. The recursive cross-quantilogram emphasizes time-varying features where two significant crisis events are spotted as the shale oil crisis and COVID-19 pandemic with a sharp increase in the lower, median, and upper quantiles. Comparing clean energy stocks with climate bonds, clean energy stocks have substantial comovement with GCC stocks while climate bonds have little comovement. Climate friendly bonds are useful for diversifying investments in GCC stocks. Our findings are of particular interest to policymakers, regulators, investors, and portfolio managers who need to understand the relationship between clean energy stocks, green bonds, and GCC stocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在识别清洁能源股票和气候友好（或绿色）债券与海湾合作委员会（GCC）股票市场在2014年九月1日至2021年九月17日期间的极端分位数依赖性。采用交叉分位数图技术，我们报告了清洁能源股票与阿联酋、卡塔尔和沙特阿拉伯股票之间存在较高的依赖性，而清洁能源股票与巴林、科威特和阿曼股票之间存在中等至较低的依赖性。气候友好债券与除阿联酋外的所有GCC股票均显示出不显著的相关性，表明这些气候友好债券对GCC股票市场具有分散化收益。递归交叉分位数图强调了时变特征，其中识别出两个重大危机事件，即页岩油危机和COVID-19大流行，其下、中、上分位数均急剧上升。将清洁能源股票与气候债券进行比较，清洁能源股票与GCC股票具有显著的联动性，而气候债券的联动性较小。气候友好债券有助于分散GCC股票的投资。我们的发现对需要理解清洁能源股票、绿色债券和GCC股票之间关系的政策制定者、监管机构、投资者和投资组合经理尤为感兴趣。

articles.title_en: Quantifying the dynamical interactions between carbon pricing and environmental protection tax in China
articles.title_cn: 量化中国碳定价与环境保护税之间的动态相互作用
articles.abstract_en: China's environmental protection tax (EPT) has been in effect since the beginning of 2018 to combat the country's severe air pollution problems. Meanwhile, carbon tax (CTX) has been identified as the most effective way of climate change mitigation. The combined effects of these two policies, in conjunction to their dynamical interactions, however, have yet been thoroughly studied. Utilizing a multiple-province computable general equilibrium (CGE) model, we compare the effects of EPT and CTX policies solely and jointly in 2030. The results show that the EPT policy has limited impact on energy-related air pollution and CO2 reduction, while the CTX policy effectively targets CO2 emissions from energy combustion processes and provides significant co-benefits in reducing air pollutants. The integration of these two policies enhances emission reduction efficiency, with the CTX policy complementing the EPT policy. Implementing CTX alongside EPT leads to substantial emissions reductions, particularly in high-industrial provinces. However, there are economic implications, as certain provinces may experience GDP losses, emphasizing the importance of equitable burden distribution. Policymakers should carefully evaluate and adjust carbon tax rates to ensure both effectiveness and fairness in achieving environmental goals.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国的环境保护税（EPT）自2018年初起实施，以应对该国严重的空气污染问题。与此同时，碳税（CTX）被认为是减缓气候变化的最有效方式。然而，这两种政策的综合效应及其动态相互作用尚未得到深入研究。利用多省份可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，我们比较了EPT和CTX政策在2030年单独实施和联合实施的效果。结果表明，EPT政策对能源相关空气污染和CO2减排的影响有限，而CTX政策有效针对能源燃烧过程中的CO2排放，并在减少空气污染物方面提供了显著的协同效益。这两种政策的整合提高了减排效率，CTX政策补充了EPT政策。在EPT基础上实施CTX可带来显著的减排效果，尤其是在高工业省份。然而，也存在经济影响，某些省份可能面临GDP损失，这强调了公平负担分配的重要性。政策制定者应仔细评估和调整碳税率，以确保在实现环境目标方面的有效性和公平性。

articles.title_en: Effects of digital global value chain participation on CO2 emissions embodied in digital exports: New evidence from PSTR approach
articles.title_cn: 数字全球价值链参与对数字出口隐含二氧化碳排放的影响：基于PSTR方法的新证据
articles.abstract_en: The technological revolution and industrial transformation led by digital technology is driving the transformation of global value chains (GVCs) to digital GVCs. To address global climate change issues while achieving economic growth, many countries prioritize practical energy-saving and emission-reduction measures while obtaining higher trade gains through participation in digital GVCs and the international division of labor. Using panel data for 60 countries and regions from 2007 to 2019, this study first measures the degree of participation in digital GVCs and the CO2 emissions embodied in digital exports. A panel smooth transition regression model is used to explore how the level of digitalization affects the impact of digital GVC participation on CO2 emissions embodied in digital exports. The empirical results show that actively participating in digital GVCs can reduce CO2 emissions embodied in digital exports, and the effect varies depending on the participation approach. Specifically, the impact of forward participation in digital GVCs (FDGVCs) on CO2 emissions exhibits an inverted U shape, indicating that the emission-reduction effect gradually appears only when the digitalization exceeds a threshold. However, backward participation in digital GVCs (BDGVCs) significantly reduces CO2 emissions, although this contribution weakens as digitalization increases. Overall, the impact strength of FDGVCs and BDGVCs on emission reduction shows a growth trend throughout the period, and the impact of FDGVCs was less than that of BDGVCs. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) and non-OECD countries have different relationships between digital GVC participation and CO2 emissions embodied in digital exports. Furthermore, the positive impact of participation in digital GVCs is consistent with CO2 emissions generated by digital export intermediates and final products. For nondigital exports, FDGVCs can significantly reduce CO2 emissions if digitalization is high. Finally, countries should actively participate in digital GVCs to promote global economic growth and sustainable development.
articles.abstract_cn: 以数字技术为主导的技术革命和产业转型正在推动全球价值链向数字全球价值链转变。为在实现经济增长的同时应对全球气候变化问题，许多国家在通过参与数字全球价值链和国际分工获得更高贸易收益的同时，优先采取切实可行的节能减碳措施。利用2007年至2019年60个国家和地区的面板数据，本研究首先测度了数字全球价值链参与程度和数字出口隐含的二氧化碳排放。采用面板平滑转换回归模型，探讨数字化水平如何影响数字全球价值链参与对数字出口隐含二氧化碳排放的作用。实证结果表明，积极参与数字全球价值链可以降低数字出口隐含的二氧化碳排放，且该效应因参与方式不同而有所差异。具体而言，数字全球价值链前向参与对二氧化碳排放的影响呈倒U型，表明只有当数字化超过某一阈值时，减排效应才逐渐显现。然而，数字全球价值链后向参与显著降低了二氧化碳排放，尽管这种贡献随着数字化程度的提高而减弱。总体来看，前向参与和后向参与对减排的影响强度在整个时期内呈增长趋势，且前向参与的影响小于后向参与。异质性分析显示，经济合作与发展组织（OECD）和非OECD国家在数字全球价值链参与与数字出口隐含二氧化碳排放之间的关系上存在差异。此外，参与数字全球价值链的积极影响与数字出口中间品和最终产品产生的二氧化碳排放相一致。对于非数字出口，如果数字化程度较高，前向参与可以显著降低二氧化碳排放。最后，各国应积极参与数字全球价值链，以促进全球经济增长和可持续发展。

articles.title_en: Social and environmental events disrupt the relation between motor gasoline prices and market fundamentals
articles.title_cn: 社会和环境事件扰乱汽车汽油价格与市场基本面之间的关系
articles.abstract_en: After the Russian invasion of Ukraine, higher prices for motor gasoline re-ignited debate about price discovery; do market fundamentals largely determine motor gasoline prices. We evaluate the degree to which market fundamentals, as proxied by prices for crude oil, taxes on motor gasoline, inventories of crude oil and motor gasoline, and refinery utilization rates, can account for prices of motor gasoline. During most of the 2010–2022 sample, these proxies for market fundamentals account for weekly changes in the price for motor gasoline. But a saturation indicator procedure identifies weeks after the Russian invasion of Ukraine, Hurricane Harvey, and the start of the Covid-19 pandemic when prices for crude oil, taxes on motor gasoline, inventories of crude oil and motor gasoline, and refinery utilization rates fail to account for weekly changes in the price of motor gasoline in a statistically significant manner. During these weeks, the price of motor gasoline rises by up to $0.25 per gallon relative to that implied by market fundamentals, which increased expenditures on motor gasoline $10 to $72 per licensed driver.
articles.abstract_cn: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，汽车汽油价格上涨重新引发了关于价格发现的辩论；市场基本面是否在很大程度上决定了汽车汽油价格。我们评估了以原油价格、汽车汽油税、原油和汽车汽油库存以及炼油厂利用率作为市场基本面代理变量的程度，这些变量能否解释汽车汽油价格。在2010-2022样本的大部分时间里，这些市场基本面的代理变量解释了汽车汽油价格的每周变化。但一个饱和指示器程序识别出在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰、飓风哈维和Covid-19大流行开始之后的几周内，原油价格、汽车汽油税、原油和汽车汽油库存以及炼油厂利用率未能以统计显著的方式解释汽车汽油价格的每周变化。在这些周内，汽车汽油价格相对于市场基本面所隐含的价格每加仑上涨高达$0.25，这使得每位持照驾驶员的汽车汽油支出增加了$10至$72。

articles.title_en: Energy price volatility affects decisions to purchase energy using capital: Motor vehicles
articles.title_cn: 能源价格波动影响购买使用能源的资本品的决策：机动车
articles.abstract_en: I investigate how energy price volatility affects consumer decisions to purchase durable, energy using capital, motor vehicles. A cointegrating vector autoregression (CVAR) model indicates that; (1) high price volatility reduces the negative effect of motor gasoline prices on monthly purchases of motor vehicles, (2) consumers consider passenger cars to be an inferior good and this drives the substitution of light trucks for passenger cars, (3) the own price elasticity of demand for vehicles is about −0.3, which is consistent with estimates used to justify The Safer Affordable Fuel-Efficient (SAFE) Vehicles Rule for Models Years 2021–2026 Passenger Cars and Light Trucks. Simulating the CVAR model indicates that implementing an energy tax rapidly or during a period of low price volatility has a greater effect on motor vehicle sales than implementing the same tax slowly or during a period of high price volatility. Together these results suggest that more research should focus on how energy price volatility affects consumer decisions to purchase energy using capital.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了能源价格波动如何影响消费者购买耐用的、使用能源的资本品（即机动车）的决策。协整向量自回归（CVAR）模型表明：（1）高价格波动降低了汽油价格对机动车月度购买的负向影响，（2）消费者认为乘用车是劣等品，这推动了轻型卡车对乘用车的替代，（3）车辆需求的自价格弹性约为−0.3，这与用于证明《更安全、负担得起、节能（SAFE）车辆规则》适用于车型年份2021-2026乘用车和轻型卡车的估计一致。模拟CVAR模型表明，快速实施能源税或在低价格波动时期实施能源税对机动车销售的影响大于缓慢实施或在价格高波动时期实施相同税收的影响。这些结果共同表明，应更多研究能源价格波动如何影响消费者购买使用能源的资本品的决策。

articles.title_en: The strategy to achieve zero‑carbon in agricultural sector: Does digitalization matter under the background of COP26 targets?
articles.title_cn: 农业部门实现零碳的战略：在COP26目标背景下数字化是否重要？
articles.abstract_en: Under the background of Conference of the Parties (COP26) targets, how to propose sustainable development policies to achieve net zero emissions is very urgent. Internet development has promoted the intellectualization of agricultural environmental governance in China. This paper adopts DEA method and Tobit model to computes the agricultural energy conservation and emission reduction efficiency, and threshold regression model to study the connection between internet advancement and the China's agricultural energy conservation and emission reduction efficiency. The emergence of the internet has a substantial beneficial influence on agricultural energy conservation and emission reduction efficiency, as demonstrated by empirical findings, and this conclusion holds true even after considering potential endogeneity. Moreover, the estimates of the threshold regression model demonstrate the rise of the internet has a double-threshold effect on China's agricultural green total factor energy efficiency (ATFEE). Specifically, the impact of internet advancement on agricultural energy conservation and emission reduction efficiency exhibits a trend of initially increasing and then declining with the regional industrial structure optimization, development of education, and technology enhancement. Therefore, digitalization takes an important part in achieving zero emissions in the agricultural sector.
articles.abstract_cn: 在缔约方大会（COP26）目标的背景下，如何提出可持续政策以实现净零排放非常紧迫。互联网发展推动了中国农业环境治理的智能化。本文采用DEA方法和Tobit模型计算农业节能减排效率，并运用门槛回归模型研究互联网发展与农业节能减排效率之间的联系。实证结果表明，互联网的出现对农业节能减排效率具有显著的积极影响，且在考虑潜在内生性后这一结论依然成立。此外，门槛回归模型的估计显示，互联网的发展对中国农业绿色全要素能源效率（ATFEE）存在双重门槛效应。具体而言，随着区域产业结构优化、教育发展和科技进步，互联网发展对农业节能减排效率的影响呈现先增后减的趋势。因此，数字化在实现农业部门零排放中发挥着重要作用。

articles.title_en: Net-zero targets for investment portfolios: An analysis of financed emissions metrics
articles.title_cn: 投资组合的净零目标：融资排放指标分析
articles.abstract_en: Financial institutions and investors aligning their investments with the objectives of the Paris Agreement, implementing the Task Force on Climate Disclosure recommendations, or seeking to reduce financial risks arising from the transition to a low-carbon economy, frequently measure, report, and set reduction targets for the emissions associated with their investments—called their ‘financed emissions.’ In this paper, we analyse the relationships between reductions in financed emissions and reductions in physical atmospheric emissions. We find that, unlike country-level GHG targets, reductions in a portfolio’s financed emissions has little direct relation to changes in physical emissions; over a 95% reduction in financed emissions can be achieved using industry-standard methods even while physical emissions from a portfolio’s companies are increasing. This creates a substantial risk of misaligning portfolios – and investment decisions – to climate mitigation efforts and net-zero commitments. We analyse the different financed emission definitions and targets currently in use and suggest alternative means by which investors can credibly align their portfolios with the transition to a low-carbon economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融机构和投资者将其投资与《巴黎协定》的目标保持一致，实施气候相关财务信息披露工作组的建议，或寻求降低向低碳经济转型所产生的金融风险，他们经常衡量、报告并设定与其投资相关的排放（称为“融资排放”）的减排目标。在本文中，我们分析了融资排放减少与物理大气排放减少之间的关系。我们发现，与国家层面的温室气体目标不同，投资组合融资排放的减少与物理排放变化几乎没有直接关系；即使投资组合中公司的物理排放正在增加，使用行业标准方法也可以实现融资排放减少超过95%。这造成了投资组合——以及投资决策——与气候减缓努力和净零承诺错位的重大风险。我们分析了目前使用的不同融资排放定义和目标，并提出了投资者可以可信地将其投资组合与向低碳经济转型保持一致的替代方法。

articles.title_en: Inflation, oil prices, and economic activity in recent crisis: Evidence from the UK
articles.title_cn: 近期危机中的通货膨胀、油价与经济活动：来自英国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the link between inflation and the macroeconomy such as output, trade balance and unemployment as reflected through crude oil prices. Using monthly data from the UK spanning January 2010 to June 2022, we apply a combination of three analyses including the VAR model, time-varying VAR analysis, and time-varying panel model with robustness. The results reveal that in the event of inflation shocks the other economic indicators decrease initially. However, Brent crude oil shocks are the quickest in responding to surging inflation compared to other proxies, rebounding to a positive level in only one month. Furthermore, the impact of inflation shocks is strong in the first quarter but diminishes in the long run. This information can be used to inform and assist policymakers to develop policies that mitigate the negative effects of inflation in the short term. Our findings also have important implications for businesses operating in the UK in making strategic decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了通货膨胀与宏观经济（如产出、贸易平衡和失业）之间的联系，这种联系通过原油价格得以反映。利用英国从2010年一月至2022年六月的月度数据，我们综合运用了三种分析方法，包括VAR模型、时变VAR分析以及具有稳健性的时变面板模型。结果表明，在通货膨胀冲击的情况下，其他经济指标最初会下降。然而，与其他代理变量相比，布伦特原油冲击对通胀飙升的响应最快，仅在一个月内就反弹至正值水平。此外，通货膨胀冲击的影响在第一季度较强，但在长期内会减弱。这些信息可用于告知和协助政策制定者制定政策，以减轻通货膨胀在短期内的负面影响。我们的发现对在英国经营的企业制定战略决策也具有重要启示。

articles.title_en: Fiscal pressure and carbon intensity: A quasi-natural experiment based on education authority reform
articles.title_cn: 财政压力与碳强度：基于教育管理改革的准自然实验
articles.abstract_en: Local governments are experiencing a sharp increase in fiscal pressures because of the slowdown in economic shifts and the external shock of COVID-19. Existing research is relatively scarce on how fiscal pressures affect carbon intensity. Therefore, this study investigated the impact of fiscal pressures on carbon intensity using a quasi-natural experiment measuring exogenous changes in fiscal pressures with the education authority reform, employing the continuous difference-in-difference technique based on a panel data set of 233 Chinese cities from 2008 to 2019. The statistical results indicate that the fiscal pressure generated by the education authority reform targets significantly increases carbon intensity. Increasing fiscal pressures boost carbon intensity by reducing government environmental concerns, upgrading industrial structure, increasing energy consumption, and weakening green technology innovation. Manifestly, the influence of fiscal pressures on promoting carbon intensity is larger in cities with low administrative prefecture levels, resource-based economies, and low financial resources.
articles.abstract_cn: 地方政府正面临财政压力的急剧增加，原因是经济转型放缓和COVID-19的外部冲击。现有研究关于财政压力如何影响碳强度的相对较少。因此，本研究利用教育管理改革作为财政压力外生变化的准自然实验，基于2008年至2019年中国233个城市的面板数据，采用连续双重差分技术，考察了财政压力对碳强度的影响。统计结果表明，教育管理改革产生的财政压力显著提高了碳强度。财政压力的增加通过降低政府环境关注度、升级产业结构、增加能源消耗和削弱绿色技术创新来促进碳强度提高。显然，在行政级别较低、资源型经济和财政资源较少的城市，财政压力对促进碳强度的影响更大。

articles.title_en: Asymmetric Effects of Energy Inflation, Agri-inflation and CPI on Agricultural Output: Evidence from NARDL and SVAR Models for the UK
articles.title_cn: 能源通胀、农业通胀与CPI对农业产出的非对称效应：基于英国NARDL和SVAR模型的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of inflation in the UK energy, agriculture and consumer sectors on agricultural output, using monthly data between February 2015 and October 2022. Existing studies on agricultural inflation – agflation – explore the impact on economic activity vis-a-vis unemployment, consumption, interest rates and agricultural production. In this paper, we consider some of the causes of agflation, particularly the role of energy prices that are of great importance at the time of writing, to the supply of food. In addition, we consider the broader context of energy price fluctuations and uncertainty. Our approach adopts a Non-Linear Autoregressive Distributed Lag (NARDL), Structural Vector Auto Regression model (SVAR), including impulse response analysis. Our findings suggest the increase in energy inflation agflation and CPI, adversely affect agricultural output, while decreases in energy inflation, agflation and CPI positively affect agricultural output in the UK. These should be of significant interest to hedge fund managers, institutional investors and economic policymakers, particularly with regard to hedging and portfolio risk diversification strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用2015年二月至2022年十月的月度数据，研究了英国能源、农业和消费部门的通胀对农业产出的影响。现有关于农业通胀（agflation）的研究探讨了其对经济活动的影响，涉及失业、消费、利率和农业生产。在本文中，我们考虑了农业通胀的一些原因，特别是能源价格的作用，这在撰写本文时对食品供应至关重要。此外，我们考虑了能源价格波动和不确定性的更广泛背景。我们的方法采用非线性自回归分布滞后模型（NARDL）、结构向量自回归模型（SVAR），包括脉冲响应分析。我们的研究结果表明，能源通胀、农业通胀和CPI的上升对农业产出产生不利影响，而能源通胀、农业通胀和CPI的下降对英国农业产出产生积极影响。这些发现应对对冲基金经理、机构投资者和经济政策制定者具有重要参考意义，尤其是在对冲和投资组合风险分散策略方面。

articles.title_en: Exploring the time-varying asymmetric effects of environmental regulation policies and human capital on sustainable development efficiency: A province level evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 环境规制政策与人力资本对可持续发展效率的时变非对称效应探究：来自中国省级的证据
articles.abstract_en: The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) for 2022 progress report indicates that global policies to reach SDGs 7 and 8 might not be as good as they could be. In the recent discussions at COP27 and in academic literature, sustainable development efficiency has also been brought up as a way to close this gap. Achieving sustainable development efficiency necessitates a favorable policy environment within economies. Environmental policies, human capital, and broader policy dimensions are just a few of the factors that influence this environment. The existing policy discourse and academic literature suggest that environmental regulation policies, human capital development, industrialization, urbanization, and GDP are potential drivers to achieve sustainable development efficiency. Hence, the study tends to erect a policy framework by investigating the time-varying effects of environmental regulation policies and human capital on sustainable development efficiency with the consort of industrialization and urbanization in a large economy—China. To this end, the study deploys the province-level panel data from 1998 to 2017 and utilizes several advanced econometric methods (Non-Parametric Panel Data Model, Wavelet Quantile Correlation, and Non-Parametric Panel Granger Causality Test). The results suggest that positive shocks in environmental regulation policies and human capital have favorable effects on sustainable development efficiency; however, their negative shocks have adverse impacts over time. Further, industrialization and urbanization significantly deteriorate the sustainable development efficiency. Based on the results, phase-wise policies are recommended in order to achieve SDGs 7 and 8.
articles.abstract_cn: 《2022年可持续发展目标进展报告》指出，全球实现可持续发展目标7和8的政策可能并未达到预期效果。在COP27的近期讨论和学术文献中，可持续发展效率也被视为缩小这一差距的途径。实现可持续发展效率需要经济体内有利的政策环境。环境政策、人力资本以及更广泛的政策维度是影响这一环境的几个因素。现有的政策讨论和学术文献表明，环境规制政策、人力资本发展、工业化、城市化和GDP是实现可持续发展效率的潜在驱动因素。因此，本研究旨在通过考察环境规制政策和人力资本对可持续发展效率的时变效应，并辅以工业化和城市化，在大型经济体——中国构建一个政策框架。为此，研究采用1998年至2017年的省级面板数据，并运用多种先进计量方法（非参数面板数据模型、小波分位数相关性和非参数面板格兰杰因果检验）。结果表明，环境规制政策和人力资本的正向冲击对可持续发展效率有积极影响；然而，其负向冲击随时间产生不利影响。此外，工业化和城市化显著降低了可持续发展效率。基于研究结果，建议分阶段制定政策以实现可持续发展目标7和8。

articles.title_en: Intensive and extensive margins of the peak load: Measuring adaptation with mixed frequency panel data
articles.title_cn: 峰值负荷的集约边际与广延边际：利用混合频率面板数据测度适应
articles.abstract_en: In this work we investigate the response of daily electricity peak load to daily maximum temperatures across states in Europe and India. We propose a method that decomposes short- from medium/long-run effects, retains the high frequency nature of the load-weather covariation and treats economic growth as a modulating factor. By simultaneously exploiting variation in unexpected daily weather anomalies and decade-long climatic changes in each location we decompose transitory - intensive margin - adjustments from permanent - extensive margin - adjustments. We find that the shocks over the long-run differ substantially from the short-run dynamics. Furthermore, we find evidence that per capita income modulates the adjustments over the short- and long-run. We project that in response to climate change around 2050 the peak load may increase by up to 20%-30% in Southern Europe and in several states in India, depending on the degree of warming and the evolution of socio-economic conditions. Even with a limited scope to two world regions, we identify that the structure of the economy and differences in future income growth matter in shaping the adaptation to climate change. Our decomposition allows to identify how future weather anomalies can further amplify the relative increase associated to the shift in the climate norm. Assuming that the interannual variability of maximum temperatures follows the distribution observed in the past, we find a doubling of the impacts of climate change during the summer in Europe. Uncertainty around the distribution of future weather anomalies may lead to further unexpected peak load amplifications. Our results have important policy implications for power systems’ generation capacity, transmission and storage, as we show that the challenges to accommodate the peak load in days with extreme temperatures may substantially increase already around mid-century.
articles.abstract_cn: 在这项工作中，我们研究了欧洲和印度各州每日电力峰值负荷对每日最高气温的响应。我们提出了一种方法，将短期效应与中期/长期效应分解开来，保留负荷-天气协变的高频特性，并将经济增长视为调节因素。通过同时利用每个地点意外的每日天气异常和长达十年的气候变化的变化，我们将暂时性（集约边际）调整与永久性（广延边际）调整分解开来。我们发现长期冲击与短期动态存在显著差异。此外，我们发现人均收入调节短期和长期调整的证据。我们预测，为应对气候变化，到2050年左右，南欧和印度几个州的峰值负荷可能增加高达20%至-30%，具体取决于变暖程度和社会经济条件的演变。即使仅限于两个世界地区，我们也发现经济结构和未来收入增长的差异在塑造对气候变化的适应方面很重要。我们的分解方法能够识别未来天气异常如何进一步放大与气候常态转变相关的相对增加。假设最高气温的年际变率遵循过去观察到的分布，我们发现欧洲夏季气候变化的影响将翻倍。未来天气异常分布的不确定性可能导致进一步的意外峰值负荷放大。我们的结果对电力系统的发电容量、输电和储能具有重要的政策意义，因为我们表明，在极端温度的日子里容纳峰值负荷的挑战可能在接近本世纪中叶时已经大幅增加。

articles.title_en: Asymmetric impact of COVID-19 news on the connectedness of the green energy, dirty energy, and non-ferrous metal markets
articles.title_cn: COVID-19新闻对绿色能源、肮脏能源和非铁金属市场关联性的非对称影响
articles.abstract_en: In the transition from dirty to green energy, non-ferrous metals are crucial. The COVID-19 pandemic has severely hampered the energy transition process and affected risk transmission between the markets for energy and metal. This article explores the asymmetric influence of COVID-19 news on the connectedness of the markets for green energy, dirty energy, and non-ferrous metal using the time-varying parameter vector autoregressive model and the nonlinear autoregressive distributed lag model. The results show that the green energy, dirty energy, and non-ferrous metal markets are closely related, with COVID-19 news acting as an external shock that strengthens this relationship. Changes in COVID-19 news increase connectedness in the short term, and diminish connectedness in the long term. Moreover, COVID-19 news has an asymmetric effect on the connectedness of the energy and metal markets. The mitigation of the coronavirus disease pandemic has a more significant impact on the connectedness than the deterioration of the pandemic. The findings can help scholars, investors, and policymakers restructure their current strategies and policies for avoiding uncertainty in the face of external shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 在从肮脏能源向绿色能源转型的过程中，非铁金属至关重要。COVID-19大流行严重阻碍了能源转型进程，并影响了能源与金属市场之间的风险传导。本文使用时变参数向量自回归模型和非线性自回归分布滞后模型，探讨了COVID-19新闻对绿色能源、肮脏能源和非铁金属市场关联性的非对称影响。结果表明，绿色能源、肮脏能源和非铁金属市场密切相关，COVID-19新闻作为外部冲击强化了这种关系。COVID-19新闻的变化在短期内增加了关联性，而在长期内降低了关联性。此外，COVID-19新闻对能源和金属市场的关联性具有非对称效应。冠状病毒病大流行的缓解对大流行恶化对关联性的影响更为显著。研究结果有助于学者、投资者和政策制定者重构其当前策略和政策，以在面临外部冲击时规避不确定性。

articles.title_en: Financial development as a new determinant of energy diversification: The role of natural capital and structural changes in Australia
articles.title_cn: 金融发展作为能源多样化的新决定因素：澳大利亚自然资本与结构性变化的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the relationship between financial development and energy diversification for Australian economy by considering natural capital, structural changes, economic growth, and export diversification as additional determinants of energy diversification demand function. The bootstrapping ARDL cointegration approach is applied for examining cointegration relationship between energy diversification and its determinants by considering presence of structural break stems in the series. Our empirical analysis reveals that financial development affects energy diversification positively. Natural capital is positively linked with energy diversification. Structural changes have favourable effect on energy diversification. Economic growth declines energy diversification. The relationship between export diversification and energy diversification is negative. Financial development and energy diversification have a nonlinear relationship between with an inverted-U shaped. The bootstrapping ARDL Granger causality analysis reveals the presence of feedback effect between financial development and energy diversification. This empirical analysis provides new policy insights for Australian policy makers using financial development as economic tool to boost up energy diversification.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过将自然资本、结构性变化、经济增长和出口多样化作为能源多样化需求函数的额外决定因素，研究了澳大利亚经济中金融发展与能源多样化之间的关系。采用自举ARDL协整方法，在考虑序列中存在结构性断点的情况下，检验能源多样化与其决定因素之间的协整关系。我们的实证分析表明，金融发展对能源多样化有正向影响。自然资本与能源多样化正相关。结构性变化对能源多样化有有利影响。经济增长降低了能源多样化。出口多样化与能源多样化之间的关系为负。金融发展与能源多样化之间存在倒U型的非线性关系。自举ARDL格兰杰因果分析揭示了金融发展与能源多样化之间存在反馈效应。这一实证分析为澳大利亚政策制定者提供了新的政策见解，即利用金融发展作为经济工具来促进能源多样化。

articles.title_en: Role of green energy usage in reduction of environmental degradation: A comparative study of East Asian countries
articles.title_cn: 绿色能源使用在减少环境退化中的作用：东亚国家的比较研究
articles.abstract_en: Global environmental sustainability is a key concern, where green energy usage is considered an important indicator. This paper aims to empirically investigate the impact of green energy usage on environmental degradation. A sample of East Asian countries is selected from 1990 to 2021. For this purpose, comparative analysis and pooled analysis are undertaken. East Asian region is chosen for study as these countries are pioneers of clean green energy usage worldwide. The impact of green energy usage on environmental sustainability is analysed along with controlling the effect of health, outcome, population, and financial development. The study's findings indicate that green energy significantly decreased environmental degradation by reducing carbon dioxide emissions in China and Japan. However, Mongolia is not a sovereign nation in producing and consuming green energy; thus, renewable energy consumption could not reduce environmental degradation there. Seemingly, pooled analysis also proved that green energy is crucial for sustainable environment in East Asia and helps policymakers globally take sustainable environmental measures, which becomes a crucial requirement for many other activities that enhance growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球环境可持续性是一个关键问题，其中绿色能源使用被视为一个重要指标。本文旨在实证研究绿色能源使用对环境退化的影响。选取了1990年至2021年的东亚国家样本。为此，进行了比较分析和汇总分析。选择东亚地区作为研究对象，因为这些国家是全球清洁绿色能源使用的先驱。在控制健康、结果、人口和金融发展的影响的同时，分析了绿色能源使用对环境可持续性的影响。研究结果表明，在中国和日本，绿色能源通过减少二氧化碳排放显著降低了环境退化。然而，蒙古在生产和使用绿色能源方面并非主权国家；因此，可再生能源消费未能减少那里的环境退化。表面上看，汇总分析也证明绿色能源对东亚的可持续环境至关重要，并帮助全球政策制定者采取可持续的环境措施，这成为许多其他促进增长活动的关键要求。

articles.title_en: Do female cadres improve clean energy accessibility in villages? Evidence from rural China
articles.title_cn: 女性干部是否改善了村庄清洁能源的可及性？来自中国农村的证据
articles.abstract_en: The active role of female cadres in promoting clean energy has received considerable attention while existing research fails to provide robust evidence. This study investigates the role of female village cadres in enhancing the accessibility of clean energy in rural areas. Using large-scale survey data from the Third Agricultural Census in China, this study presents a robust effect of female cadres on clean energy accessibility and plausible mechanisms in rural areas. The findings indicate that female cadres have a positive impact on the natural gas connection and connection rate within the village, with an increase of 1.7% and 1.4%, respectively. Moreover, the heterogeneity analyses reveal that the positive impact of female cadres is particularly pronounced in villages situated in mountainous regions. Additionally, the accessibility of clean energy can be effectively enhanced by the presence of female cadres in the village, particularly when their proportion reaches approximately 87%. The contributions of female cadres are more considerable when the village is more likely to elect female cadres. Furthermore, the identification of mechanisms suggests that female cadres improve clean energy accessibility by promoting entrepreneurship, developing the collective economy, and providing elderly care services. Based on these findings, several policy implications are proposed to facilitate access to clean energy in rural areas.
articles.abstract_cn: 女性干部在推广清洁能源方面的积极作用已受到相当关注，但现有研究未能提供稳健的证据。本研究探讨了女性村干部在提高农村地区清洁能源可及性方面的作用。利用中国第三次农业普查的大规模调查数据，本研究展示了女性干部对清洁能源可及性的稳健效应及其在农村地区的可能机制。研究结果表明，女性干部对村内天然气接通及接通率有积极影响，分别提高了1.7%和1.4%。此外，异质性分析显示，女性干部的积极影响在位于山区的村庄尤为显著。另外，当女性干部在村庄中的比例达到约87%时，其存在能有效提升清洁能源的可及性。当村庄更有可能选举女性干部时，女性干部的贡献更为显著。进一步地，机制识别表明，女性干部通过促进创业、发展集体经济和提供养老服务来改善清洁能源的可及性。基于这些发现，提出了若干政策建议以促进农村地区清洁能源的获取。

articles.title_en: The impact of carbon emission trading policy on overcapacity of companies: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 碳排放交易政策对企业产能过剩的影响：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: As a market incentive-based environmental regulation, the carbon emission trading (CET) policy is an important tool for China to achieve “carbon peak” and “carbon neutrality” goals. However, it is not clear how the CET policy will affect companies' overcapacity. Given this, based on collecting the list of the CET pilot companies, this paper uses the difference-in-differences (DID) model to explore the impact of the CET policy on companies' overcapacity. It's found that the CET policy will significantly aggravate companies' overcapacity. The results of the mechanism analysis show that the CET policy will expand companies' fixed assets investment, reduce their turnover of fixed assets, and increase the credit support and green subsidies provided by the government to companies, thereby leading to a disorderly expansion of capacity. Besides, heterogeneity analysis shows that companies' overcapacity aggravation caused by the CET policy is more prominent in regions with low marketization levels, backward economic development levels, and weak environmental regulation intensity, state-owned companies and companies with low R&D levels. This paper not only provides new research literature for the CET policy and overcapacity, but also provides more empirical evidence at the micro level for the continuous improvement of the national CET market.
articles.abstract_cn: 作为基于市场激励的环境规制，碳排放交易（CET）政策是中国实现“碳达峰”和“碳中和”目标的重要工具。然而，CET政策将如何影响企业产能过剩尚不清楚。鉴于此，本文在收集CET试点企业名单的基础上，采用双重差分（DID）模型探讨CET政策对企业产能过剩的影响。研究发现，CET政策将显著加剧企业产能过剩。机制分析结果表明，CET政策将扩大企业固定资产投资，降低其固定资产周转率，并增加政府向企业提供的信贷支持和绿色补贴，从而导致产能无序扩张。此外，异质性分析表明，CET政策导致的企业产能过剩加剧在市场化水平低、经济发展水平落后、环境规制强度弱的地区，以及国有企业和研发水平低的企业中更为突出。本文不仅为CET政策与产能过剩提供了新的研究文献，也为全国碳排放权交易市场的不断完善提供了微观层面的更多经验证据。

articles.title_en: Decomposed oil price shocks and GCC stock market sector returns and volatility
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates dynamic mean and tail-based connectedness between decomposed oil price shocks (demand shock, supply shock, and risk shock) and Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) stock returns and volatility at the aggregate and sectoral levels of stock data. The sample period is January 13, 2012 - January 14, 2022, covering calm and turbulent periods. The results of mean-based connectedness show generally low levels of connectedness over the full sample period for both return and volatility, despite some time-variation and irregularity in the patterns of connectedness across stock sectors. Total, directional, and pairwise connectedness measures surge significantly during Phase 1 of COVID-19, highlighting the pandemic's influence on the oil shocks–GCC stocks nexus. However, Phase 2 of COVID-19 displays a gradual reduction in return and volatility connectedness, which could be attributed to fiscal stimulus and COVID19 relief packages adopted by policymakers to contain the adverse impact of the virus on the economy. Quantile-based connectedness measures reveal evidence of heterogeneity in the impacts of oil shocks across the various quantiles of stock sector returns and volatility. Unlike supply shock, demand shock is a net transmitter of spillovers, irrespective of the quantiles. Volatility connectedness is stronger at the high volatility state than the moderate and low volatility states for all sectors, but strongest for the industrials sector. The results indicate that modelling oil shocks and GCC stock sector returns and volatility should concentrate on the most influential oil shocks (e.g. demand shock) affecting the lower and upper quantiles of sector returns and upper quantiles of sector volatility, especially for the industrials. The findings have implications for improving portfolio risk management and regulatory procedures, which should be necessary to address spillover effects from decomposed oil shocks in the stock markets of oil-exporters such as GCC countries.

articles.title_en: On-demand energy flexibility market via smart contracts to help reduce balancing costs in Great Britain
articles.title_cn: 通过智能合约实现按需灵活性电力市场，以帮助降低英国平衡成本
articles.abstract_en: The large deployment of renewable generation required to reach net-zero carbon emission requires significant investments in transmission network infrastructure to reduce grid congestion, as well as costly investments in dispatchable assets to manage the intermittency of renewable energy. The provision of flexibility services to system operators represents an additional method that could help solve these issues. However, this requires the engagement of a large number of small users, such as households and small commercial firms, that usually cannot directly participate in electricity markets due to their limited size. Blockchain technologies leveraging smart contracts can provide an autonomous, cost-saving and transparent tool to help engage these users in the provision of flexibility services to the grid. The aim of this paper is to design a new market layer for the on-demand provision of flexibility services by using smart contracts fully integrated with existing national-scale electricity markets. We demonstrate how this model can co-exist with the current electricity market architecture in Great Britain (GB), providing a whole-system least-cost solution to solve grid congestion and energy imbalances. Simulations based on a high-fidelity network of GB highlight the potential benefit that the proposed approach could create at the national scale.
articles.abstract_cn: 为实现净零碳排放而大规模部署可再生能源发电，需要对输电网基础设施进行大量投资以减少电网拥堵，同时还需要对可调度资产进行昂贵投资以管理可再生能源的间歇性。向系统运营商提供灵活性服务是解决这些问题的另一种方法。然而，这需要大量小型用户（如家庭和小型商业企业）的参与，这些用户通常因其规模有限而无法直接参与电力市场。利用智能合约的区块链技术可以提供一种自主、节省成本且透明的工具，帮助这些用户参与向电网提供灵活性服务。本文旨在设计一个新的市场层级，通过智能合约提供按需灵活性服务，并与现有的国家级电力市场完全集成。我们展示了该模型如何与英国（GB）当前的电力市场架构共存，为解决电网拥堵和能源不平衡提供全系统最低成本解决方案。基于英国高保真网络的模拟突出了所提方法在全国范围内可能创造的潜在效益。

articles.title_en: Potential policy coordination: Can energy intensity targets affect energy poverty?
articles.title_cn: 潜在的政策协同：能源强度目标能否影响能源贫困？
articles.abstract_en: China's central government began setting mandatory energy intensity targets for provincial governments in the first year of the Eleventh Five-Year Plan. In addition to ensuring China's sustainable reduction of energy intensity, energy intensity targets may also have the policy coordination effect of alleviating energy poverty. Based on panel data of 30 provinces in China from 2006 to 2020, this paper empirically studies the impact of energy intensity targets on energy poverty. Asymmetric analysis is also conducted in this paper, as well as an exploration of the potential mechanisms through which energy intensity targets affect energy poverty. The research conclusions are as follows: (1) Energy intensity targets have a significant policy coordination effect of alleviating energy poverty, even though that is not the intended policy purpose. (2) In regions with better energy infrastructure, industrial structure distortions can enlarge the impact of energy intensity targets on alleviating energy poverty. However, in disadvantaged areas, industrial structure distortions do not moderate the impact of energy intensity targets on energy poverty. (3) There is a heterogeneous relationship between energy intensity targets and energy poverty at different quantiles. The energy poverty alleviation effect of energy intensity targets is stronger in regions with more severe energy poverty. But in regions where energy poverty is not severe, energy intensity targets have no significant impact on energy poverty. (4) Energy poverty exhibits a clear spatial correlation. Energy intensity targets not only affect local energy poverty, but also affect energy poverty in adjacent areas, indicating that the impact of energy intensity targets on energy poverty has significant spatial correlation characteristics. We also make suggestions for policy coordination in the energy sector.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国中央政府自“十一五”规划第一年起，开始对省级政府设定强制性能源强度目标。除了确保中国能源强度的可持续降低外，能源强度目标还可能具有缓解能源贫困的政策协同效应。基于2006年至2020年中国30个省份的面板数据，本文实证研究了能源强度目标对能源贫困的影响。本文还进行了非对称分析，并探讨了能源强度目标影响能源贫困的潜在机制。研究结论如下：（1）能源强度目标具有显著的缓解能源贫困的政策协同效应，尽管这并非政策初衷。（2）在能源基础设施较好的地区，产业结构扭曲会放大能源强度目标对缓解能源贫困的影响。然而，在欠发达地区，产业结构扭曲并未调节能源强度目标对能源贫困的影响。（3）在不同分位数上，能源强度目标与能源贫困之间存在异质性关系。在能源贫困较为严重的地区，能源强度目标的减贫效应更强。但在能源贫困不严重的地区，能源强度目标对能源贫困没有显著影响。（4）能源贫困表现出明显的空间相关性。能源强度目标不仅影响本地区能源贫困，还影响邻近地区的能源贫困，表明能源强度目标对能源贫困的影响具有显著的空间相关特征。我们还为能源部门的政策协同提出了建议。

articles.title_en: INE oil futures volatility prediction: Exchange rates or international oil futures volatility?
articles.title_cn: INE原油期货波动率预测：汇率还是国际原油期货波动率？
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the predictive performances of volatility information from international oil futures volatility and exchange rates for Shanghai International Energy Exchange (INE) oil futures volatility. Various empirical findings show that the predictive performance of international oil futures volatility is superior to that of the exchange rate. In addition, we examine whether regime switching is efficient, and the results show that time-varying regime switching plays a satisfactory role. Moreover, these results are robust even during some special periods, including the COVID-19 pandemic, the Russia–Ukraine conflict, and different business cycles. This study provides new insights into the volatility prediction of the INE oil futures market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了国际原油期货波动率和汇率的信息对上海国际能源交易中心（INE）原油期货波动率的预测性能。多项实证发现表明，国际原油期货波动率的预测性能优于汇率。此外，我们检验了机制转换是否有效，结果显示时变机制转换发挥了令人满意的角色。而且，这些结果即使在特殊时期，包括COVID-19大流行、俄罗斯-乌克兰冲突以及不同的商业周期中也是稳健的。本研究为INE原油期货市场的波动率预测提供了新的见解。

articles.title_en: Green finance and energy transition to achieve net-zero emission target
articles.title_cn: 绿色金融与能源转型以实现净零排放目标
articles.abstract_en: This study measured the effects of green financing and energy transition on COP26 targets for 40 countries, namely, 14 economies with market-based financial systems and 26 countries with bank-based financial systems, from 2010 to 2020. The findings confirmed that, in the market-based financial system, GDP per capita has a positive coefficient, while for countries with a bank-based financial system, GDP per capita has a negative coefficient on greenhouse gas emissions. With a 1% improvement in the energy transition of countries under a market-based financial structure, greenhouse gas emissions will decrease by 0.08%. The central practical policies recommended by this research are enhancing green loans, bank financing, and green bank guarantees.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究衡量了2010年至2020年间绿色融资和能源转型对40个国家（即14个市场主导型金融体系经济体和26个银行主导型金融体系国家）的COP26目标的影响。研究结果证实，在市场主导型金融体系中，人均GDP对温室气体排放具有正系数，而在银行主导型金融体系国家中，人均GDP对温室气体排放具有负系数。在市场主导型金融结构下，能源转型每改善1%，温室气体排放将减少0.08%。本研究推荐的核心实用政策是加强绿色贷款、银行融资和绿色银行担保。

articles.title_en: Enhancing borrowing-firm equity through renewable energy adoption, consumer green awareness, and insurer sustainable finance
articles.title_cn: 通过可再生能源采用、消费者绿色意识与保险公司可持续融资增强借款企业股权
articles.abstract_en: Small and medium-sized manufacturers increasingly adopt renewable energy sources for sustainable production but often require funds from financial institutions that prioritize sustainability. This study develops a capped call option model to evaluate an insurer's equity while considering the credit risks associated with a manufacturing borrower's renewable energy adoption. The study finds that a win-win situation can be achieved through renewable energy adoption with sustainable finance, with the insurer's interest margin and the manufacturer's equity value increasing. Furthermore, consumer green awareness also contributes to a win-win situation. However, implementing a stringent regulatory cap under the cap-and-trade mechanism can negatively impact the win-win structure, despite yielding insurance stability. The results suggest that when regulatory authorities conduct a cap-and-trade scheme, sustainable finance providers and manufacturing borrowers are more likely to contribute to environmental improvement through renewable energy adoption for production. Overall, this study highlights the potential benefits of renewable energy adoption and sustainable finance for manufacturers and insurers, as well as the positive impact of consumer green awareness. The findings can inform policymakers and market players in developing effective strategies to promote sustainable production and financial stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 中小型制造商越来越多地采用可再生能源进行可持续生产，但往往需要从优先考虑可持续性的金融机构获得资金。本研究构建了一个封顶看涨期权模型，在考虑制造借款方可再生能源采用相关信用风险的情况下评估保险公司的股权。研究发现，通过可持续融资的可再生能源采用可以实现双赢局面，保险公司的利差和制造商的股权价值均有所增加。此外，消费者绿色意识也有助于实现双赢。然而，在总量管制与交易机制下实施严格的监管上限可能对双赢结构产生负面影响，尽管这能带来保险稳定性。结果表明，当监管当局实施总量管制与交易计划时，可持续融资提供方和制造借款方更有可能通过采用可再生能源进行生产来促进环境改善。总体而言，本研究强调了可再生能源采用和可持续融资对制造商和保险公司的潜在益处，以及消费者绿色意识的积极影响。研究结果可为政策制定者和市场参与者制定促进可持续生产和金融稳定的有效策略提供参考。

articles.title_en: The risk spillover of high carbon enterprises in China: Evidence from the stock market
articles.title_cn: 中国高碳企业的风险溢出：来自股票市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the time-varying risk spillover among high carbon enterprises by constructing Granger-causality networks from 2011 to 2021, and explore the types of high carbon enterprises that have stronger risk spillover capabilities. Additionally, we also expanded our analysis on the risk spillovers from high carbon enterprises to non-high carbon enterprises. We find that the intensity of risk spillover among high carbon stocks strengthened from 2013 to 2016, then weakened, and slightly re-strengthened in 2020. High carbon enterprises from power, steel, aviation, and petrochemical industries occupy central positions in the networks. Moreover, fundamental factors such as asset scale, profitability, capital structure, ownership, and industry category significantly influence the connectivity and centrality of high carbon enterprises in the networks. Meanwhile, the high carbon enterprises with higher connectivity and central location in the networks have greater systemic risk contributions. Finally, we find that the non-high carbon enterprises from agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fishery industry, mining industry and transportation, warehousing and postal industry are more susceptible to the risk overflow from high carbon enterprises.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过构建2011年至2021年的格兰杰因果网络，考察了高碳企业之间的时变风险溢出，并探讨了具有更强风险溢出能力的高碳企业类型。此外，我们还扩展了对高碳企业向非高碳企业风险溢出的分析。我们发现，高碳股票之间的风险溢出强度在2013年至2016年期间增强，随后减弱，并在2020年略有重新增强。来自电力、钢铁、航空和石化行业的高碳企业在网络中占据中心位置。此外，资产规模、盈利能力、资本结构、所有权和行业类别等基本面因素显著影响高碳企业在网络中的连通性和中心性。同时，网络中连通性更高且处于中心位置的高碳企业具有更大的系统性风险贡献。最后，我们发现来自农林牧渔业、采矿业以及交通运输、仓储和邮政业的非高碳企业更容易受到高碳企业风险溢出的影响。

articles.title_en: Fuelling down after a lockdown: Effects of the first COVID wave on clean fuel usage in India
articles.title_cn: 封锁后的燃料下降：第一波新冠疫情对印度清洁燃料使用的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study explores the effect of the outbreak of COVID-19 on clean fuel adoption in rural India. We make use of the fifth wave of the National Family and Health Survey conducted from 2019 to 2021, focusing on districts which the survey was conducted during in the pre-pandemic and post-first wave periods. By utilizing the exposure of households to the pandemic, depending on the date of the survey for identification, we find that the first wave of the pandemic led to a significant reduction in the use of clean fuel for cooking purposes. We are able to establish that this decline is not a mere time trend, since we do not find any evidence of a negative trend in clean fuel usage during the pre-pandemic period. Additionally, we do not observe any reduction in households from states where the survey was conducted entirely during the pre-pandemic period. Our results remain robust in the presence of potential endogeneity due to unobserved factors in the system. Even when employing a difference-in-difference model using the previous round of the survey, we find a lower likelihood of clean fuel usage among households where the survey was conducted after the first wave vis-à-vis those surveyed in the pre-pandemic period. Nevertheless, the impact appears to be adverse for the relatively more vulnerable households. The findings underscore the need for policies, like subsidies and reducing refilling costs of liquefied petroleum gas cylinders, to sustain clean fuel use in the wake of the pandemic.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了COVID-19疫情爆发对印度农村地区清洁燃料采用的影响。我们利用了2019年至2021年进行的第五轮全国家庭与健康调查数据，重点关注在疫情前和第一波疫情后期间进行调查的地区。通过利用家庭暴露于疫情的程度，根据调查日期进行识别，我们发现第一波疫情导致烹饪用清洁燃料的使用显著减少。我们能够确定这种下降并非单纯的时间趋势，因为在疫情前期间我们没有发现清洁燃料使用存在负面趋势的证据。此外，我们未观察到在完全于疫情前期间进行调查的邦中家庭使用减少。在存在由于系统中未观测因素导致的潜在内生性时，我们的结果仍然稳健。即使采用使用上一轮调查数据的双重差分模型，我们也发现第一波疫情后调查的家庭相对于疫情前调查的家庭，清洁燃料使用的可能性较低。然而，这种影响对相对更脆弱的家庭似乎更为不利。研究结果强调了需要采取诸如补贴和降低液化石油气钢瓶加注成本等政策，以在疫情后维持清洁燃料的使用。

articles.title_en: The net climate effect of digitalization, differentiating between firms and households
articles.title_cn: 数字化的净气候效应：区分企业与家庭
articles.abstract_en: While public debate and prominent studies expect digitalization to substantially reduce energy use and carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions, quantitative research has produced ambiguous results. This study addresses the challenges in the analysis of the relationship between a country’s digitalization level and CO2 emissions by employing the Group Fixed Effects estimator for panel data of EU and OECD countries and by differentiating between emissions associated with digitalization in firms and households.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管公众辩论和著名研究预期数字化将大幅减少能源使用和二氧化碳（CO2）排放，但定量研究产生了模糊的结果。本研究通过采用欧盟和OECD国家面板数据的组固定效应估计量，并区分企业与家庭中与数字化相关的排放，来解决分析国家数字化水平与CO2排放之间关系所面临的挑战。

articles.title_en: Economic growth and the use of natural resources: assessing the moderating role of institutions
articles.title_cn: 经济增长与自然资源利用：评估制度的调节作用
articles.abstract_en: We analyze how countries with different institutional settings use natural resources for economic growth. For a panel of 159 countries over the period 1992–2010, we estimate how the effect of a permanent increase in the growth rate of GDP on the growth rate of resource use depends on political institutional quality. We study this relationship for total resource use and for its subclasses fossil fuels, biomass, non-metallic minerals, and metal ores. Our results show that the effect of an increase of economic growth on total resource use growth is higher for countries with higher political institutional quality. This result holds for the subclasses biomass and non-metallic minerals and in most specifications for metal ores. In contrast, we find no positive association for fossil fuels. We reconcile our results with endogenous growth theory and suggest technology and input prices as transmission channels. In this interpretation, our results highlight that institutions provide important framework conditions, but they are no general panacea to further decrease the resource dependency of economic growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了具有不同制度环境的国家如何利用自然资源促进经济增长。对于1992-2010年间159个国家的面板数据，我们估计了GDP增长率永久性提高对资源使用增长率的影响如何取决于政治制度质量。我们研究了这一关系对于总资源使用及其子类化石燃料、生物质、非金属矿物和金属矿石的影响。我们的结果表明，对于政治制度质量较高的国家，经济增长对总资源使用增长的影响更大。这一结果在生物质和非金属矿物子类以及大多数金属矿石的规格中均成立。相比之下，我们发现化石燃料没有正相关关系。我们将我们的结果与内生增长理论相协调，并提出技术和投入价格作为传导渠道。在这种解释下，我们的结果强调制度提供了重要的框架条件，但并非进一步降低经济增长资源依赖性的普遍灵丹妙药。

articles.title_en: Beyond capacity: Contractual form in electricity reliability obligations
articles.title_cn: 超越容量：电力可靠性义务中的合同形式
articles.abstract_en: Liberalized electricity markets often include resource adequacy mechanisms that require consumers to contract with generation resources well in advance of real-time operations. While administratively defined mechanisms have most commonly taken the form of a capacity obligation, efficient markets would feature a broad array of arrangements adapted to the risk profiles and appetites of market participants. This article considers how the financial hedge embedded in alternative resource adequacy contract designs can induce different responses from risk-averse investors, with consequences for the resource mix and market structure. We construct a stochastic equilibrium model describing a competitive market with incomplete risk trading and compute investment equilibria under different contracting regimes. Two policy recommendations result. First, to avoid creating inefficiency by crowding out other forms of risk sharing, system operators should allow resources contracted through other means to opt out of mandatory capacity mechanisms, with their contribution to those requirements subtracted from administratively defined demand curves. Second, if they wish to promote a single contractual form, regulators should consider replacing existing option-like capacity mechanisms with a shaped forward contract for energy. Beyond these recommendations, we discuss the tension that liberalized systems face in seeking to promote both reliability and competitive outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 自由化的电力市场通常包含资源充足性机制，要求消费者提前于实时运行与发电资源签订合同。虽然行政定义的机制最常见的形式是容量义务，但高效市场应具有适应市场参与者风险状况和偏好的广泛安排。本文考虑了替代性资源充足性合同设计中嵌入的金融对冲如何诱导风险厌恶投资者的不同反应，从而对资源组合和市场结构产生影响。我们构建了一个描述不完全风险交易竞争市场的随机均衡模型，并计算了不同合同制度下的投资均衡。由此得出两项政策建议。首先，为避免通过挤出其他风险分担形式而造成低效率，系统运营商应允许通过其他方式签约的资源选择退出强制性容量机制，其对这些要求的贡献应从行政定义的需求曲线中扣除。其次，如果希望推广单一合同形式，监管机构应考虑用有形状的能源远期合同替代现有的期权式容量机制。除这些建议外，我们还讨论了自由化系统在寻求同时促进可靠性和竞争性结果时所面临的紧张关系。

articles.title_en: How do the designs of emission trading system affect the value of covered firms—A quasi-natural experiment based on China
articles.title_cn: 碳排放权交易制度设计如何影响被覆盖企业价值——基于中国的准自然实验
articles.abstract_en: Under the effective cost constraint, the emission trading system (ETS) can put pressure on the covered firms to cut emissions through reasonable system designs. Under the ETS with different system designs, firms face different cost constraints. Therefore, how ETS designs affect the value of covered firms is important to evaluate the effectiveness of ETS. Based on the Chinese A-share listed firms from 2010 to 2019, this paper employs DID, Mediation-DID, and Moderated Mediation Methods to investigate the influence of system designs of seven pilot ETSs on the value of covered firms. The main findings are as follows. First, in general, the value of covered firms is improved by the implementation of pilot ETSs. Compared with free allowances, paid allowances have a stronger promotion effect on firm value, in which the technology innovation plays a positive mediation role. Second, from the perspective of free allowances, the benchmarking method can promote firm value more effectively than the historical method, through the paths of technology innovation and carbon information disclosure (CID). Third, the increase of carbon price level and its stability can promote firm value. Specifically, the carbon price level only promotes firm value through CID, while the carbon price stability promotes firm value through technology innovation and weakens firm value through CID. Moreover, for firms owned by the State or in high‑carbon industries, the value improvement effect of ETS is more significant.
articles.abstract_cn: 在有效成本约束下，碳排放权交易制度（ETS）可以通过合理的制度设计对被覆盖企业施加减排压力。在不同制度设计的ETS下，企业面临不同的成本约束。因此，ETS设计如何影响被覆盖企业的价值，对于评估ETS的有效性至关重要。基于2010年至2019年中国A股上市公司数据，本文采用双重差分法（DID）、中介效应双重差分法（Mediation-DID）和有调节的中介效应方法，考察七个试点ETS的制度设计对被覆盖企业价值的影响。主要发现如下：第一，总体而言，试点ETS的实施提升了被覆盖企业的价值。与免费配额相比，有偿配额对企业价值具有更强的促进作用，其中技术创新发挥了正向中介作用。第二，从免费配额的角度看，基准法比历史法更能有效促进企业价值，其路径是通过技术创新和碳信息披露（CID）。第三，碳价格水平及其稳定性的提高可以促进企业价值。具体而言，碳价格水平仅通过CID促进企业价值，而碳价格稳定性通过技术创新促进企业价值，并通过CID削弱企业价值。此外，对于国有控股或高碳行业的企业，ETS的价值提升效应更为显著。

articles.title_en: Pricing inconsistency between the futures and Financial Transmission Right markets in North America
articles.title_cn: 北美期货与金融输电权市场之间的定价不一致性
articles.abstract_en: An empirical comparison of prices for two categories of financial derivatives of the NYISO, PJM and ISO-NE power markets, namely Financial Transmission Right (FTR) and futures contracts, is performed. The objective is to assess whether these two categories of derivatives are priced consistently, as their payoffs partially overlap. Statistical metrics reveal that implied prices for the loss component of the power price, which are obtained by combining information provided by both FTR and futures prices, are more volatile than corresponding realized loss values. This contradicts the idea of a price being a probability-weighted average of possible realized values, and therefore indicates the presence of the pricing misalignment between the FTR and futures markets of the three power markets during the period covered by the data sample.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文对NYISO、PJM和ISO-NE电力市场的两类金融衍生品，即金融输电权（FTR）和期货合约的价格进行了实证比较。目的是评估这两类衍生品是否定价一致，因为它们的收益部分重叠。统计指标显示，通过结合FTR和期货价格信息得出的电力价格损失部分的隐含价格，比相应的已实现损失值更具波动性。这与价格是可能实现值的概率加权平均的观点相矛盾，因此表明在数据样本覆盖期间，三个电力市场的FTR和期货市场之间存在定价错位。

articles.title_en: Saving energy by cleaning the air?: Endogenous energy efficiency and energy conservation potential
articles.title_cn: 通过清洁空气节约能源？：内生能源效率与节能潜力
articles.abstract_en: Estimating the impact of air quality on productivity poses significant challenges, primarily due to issues of endogeneity and the potential correlation between errors in the traditional two-step approach. This approach involves calculating productivity in the initial step and subsequently estimating the impact in the second step. To address these challenges, we employ an endogenous stochastic frontier analysis framework to identify the causal effect of air quality on energy efficiency in China. Our findings reveal a strong negative relationship between air quality and energy efficiency. A 10% increase in daily average PM2.5 concentrations results in a decrease in energy efficiency by 5%. The detrimental impact of air pollution on energy efficiency is particularly pronounced in cities characterized by outdated production technology or higher levels of market competition. Furthermore, our analysis highlights two primary mechanisms through which air pollution impedes the improvement of energy efficiency: by inhibiting innovation activities and constraining the development of the tertiary industry. Lastly, by assessing the potential improvement in air quality, we estimate a significant energy conservation potential of 1037.45–2192.79 million kilowatt-hours during the period from 2004 to 2017. On the condition that fossil energy still dominates the energy structure in current China, improved energy efficiency can lead to less emissions. The measures on reducing the air pollution can achieve much larger effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 估算空气质量对生产率的影响面临重大挑战，主要源于内生性问题以及传统两步法中误差之间可能存在的相关性。该方法首先计算生产率，然后在第二步中估算其影响。为应对这些挑战，我们采用内生随机前沿分析框架来识别中国空气质量对能源效率的因果效应。我们的研究结果显示，空气质量与能源效率之间存在强烈的负相关关系。日平均PM2.5浓度每增加10%，能源效率下降5%。空气污染对能源效率的不利影响在那些生产技术落后或市场竞争程度较高的城市尤为显著。此外，我们的分析强调了空气污染阻碍能源效率提升的两个主要机制：抑制创新活动和限制第三产业的发展。最后，通过评估空气质量的潜在改善，我们估计在2004年至2017年期间，节能潜力显著，约为1037.45至2192.79百万千瓦时。在当前中国能源结构仍以化石能源为主的条件下，能源效率的提高可以减少排放。减少空气污染的措施可以产生更大的效果。

articles.title_en: The historical role of energy in UK inflation and productivity with implications for price inflation
articles.title_cn: 能源在英国通胀和生产率中的历史作用及其对价格通胀的影响
articles.abstract_en: We model UK price and wage inflation, productivity and unemployment over a century and a half of data, selecting dynamics, relevant variables, non-linearities and location and trend shifts using indicator saturation estimation. The four congruent econometric equations highlight complex interacting empirical relations. The production function reveals a major role for energy inputs additional to capital and labour, and although the price inflation equation shows a small direct impact of energy prices, the substantial rise in oil and gas prices seen by mid-2022 contribute half of the increase in price inflation. We find empirical evidence for non-linear adjustments of real wages to inflation: a wage-price spiral kicks in when inflation exceeds about 6%–8% p.a. We also find an additional non-linear reaction to unemployment, consistent with involuntary unemployment. A reduction in energy availability simultaneously reduces output and exacerbates inflation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个半世纪的数据对英国价格和工资通胀、生产率及失业进行建模，通过指示饱和估计选择动态、相关变量、非线性和位置及趋势变化。四个一致的计量方程凸显了复杂的交互经验关系。生产函数揭示了能源投入除资本和劳动力外的重要作用，尽管价格通胀方程显示能源价格的直接影响较小，但到2022年中期观察到的石油和天然气价格大幅上涨贡献了价格通胀增幅的一半。我们发现了实际工资对通胀非线性调整的经验证据：当通胀超过每年约6%–8%时，工资-价格螺旋开始启动。我们还发现对失业存在额外的非线性反应，与自愿失业一致。能源可用性的减少同时降低了产出并加剧了通胀。

articles.title_en: Estimating pass-through rates for the 2022 tax reduction on fuel prices in Germany
articles.title_cn: 估算2022年德国燃油税减免的传导率
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the effectiveness of the German tax reduction on fuel prices (‘Tankrabatt’) that was introduced for three months, starting on 1 June 2022. We use the synthetic difference-in-differences estimator to compare actual retail prices of gasoline and diesel to those in a counterfactual situation without the tax reduction. For gasoline, we find that the tax reduction has been completely passed on to consumers. This result is robust to different approaches of constructing the synthetic control group. For diesel, we find evidence of at least partial pass-through, although the estimates are more sensitive to the employed specification. Moreover, the evidence suggests that pass-through rates for diesel started to decline in August while the tax reduction was still in place.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了德国为期三个月的燃油税减免（‘Tankrabatt’）的有效性，该减免自2022年六月1日起实施。我们使用合成双重差分估计器，将汽油和柴油的实际零售价格与没有税收减免的反事实情况进行比较。对于汽油，我们发现税收减免已完全传导给消费者。这一结果对于构建合成对照组的不同方法均具有稳健性。对于柴油，我们发现至少存在部分传导的证据，尽管估计值对所使用的设定更为敏感。此外，证据表明，柴油的传导率在八月开始下降，而税收减免仍在实施中。

articles.title_en: Energy security and economic stability: The role of inflation and war
articles.title_cn: 能源安全与经济稳定：通货膨胀与战争的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of energy security risk (ESR) on economic stability. Using multiple global datasets, we provide empirical evidence from a panel of 68 countries spanning over a period from 1980 to 2021. Our results indicate that high ESR reduces GDP growth rate (GDPG) from a global perspective. In robustness tests, this effect remains valid across several specifications based on non-U.S. samples, national income-level, alternative measure of economic stability, and a set of endogeneity tests based on propensity score matching estimation. Countries with pre-existing low GDPG mainly suffer from heightened energy insecurity. Further tests reveal that numerous country-specific institutional quality estimates moderate the effect. Finally, the damaging impact of ESR worsens during years of high inflation, geopolitical risk and acts, as well as of escalated war threats. We encourage international collaborations to develop a more sustainable energy system, which enhances the security of energy supply and the stability of economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了能源安全风险（ESR）对经济稳定的影响。利用多个全球数据集，我们提供了来自68个国家面板数据的实证证据，时间跨度从1980年到2021年。我们的结果表明，从全球视角来看，高ESR降低了GDP增长率（GDPG）。在稳健性检验中，这一效应在基于非美国样本、国民收入水平、经济稳定的替代衡量指标以及基于倾向得分匹配估计的一组内生性检验的多种设定中仍然有效。原本GDPG较低的国家主要遭受能源不安全加剧的影响。进一步检验显示，许多国家特定的制度质量估计值调节了这一效应。最后，ESR的破坏性影响在高通胀、地缘政治风险和行动以及战争威胁升级的年份中加剧。我们鼓励国际合作以发展更可持续的能源系统，这能增强能源供应的安全性和经济的稳定性。

articles.title_en: What is the role of perceived oil price shocks in inflation expectations?
articles.title_cn: 感知油价冲击在通胀预期中的作用是什么？
articles.abstract_en: Not much. We identify the perceived oil price shock, as well as perceived global demand and supply shocks, using sign restrictions in a factor-augmented vector autoregression model that includes forecasts for crude oil price growth, real GDP growth, and inflation across 84 economies. The perceived oil price shock explains only 10% of the fluctuations, on average, in global inflation expectations from January 2012 to December 2022, and accounts for an even smaller fraction during the COVID-19 pandemic. Allowing for the oil price noise shock – reflecting exogenous shifts in agents’ optimism and pessimism – does not materially change the limited pass-through of the perceived oil price shock to inflation expectations. In contrast, perceived global supply and demand shocks dominate, especially since the onset of the pandemic. Over the first eight months, professional forecasters viewed the pandemic, on net, as a negative demand shock and lowered their short-term inflation expectations. In early 2021, professionals quickly switched their views and sharply increased their inflation expectations amid burgeoning and persistent supply chain disruptions and labor constraints.
articles.abstract_cn: 作用不大。我们通过在一个包含84个经济体的原油价格增长、实际GDP增长和通胀预测的因子增强向量自回归模型中，使用符号限制来识别感知的油价冲击，以及感知的全球需求和供给冲击。从2012年一月到2022年十二月，感知的油价冲击平均仅解释了全球通胀预期波动的10%，在COVID-19大流行期间所占比例甚至更小。允许油价噪声冲击——反映代理人乐观和悲观情绪的外生变化——并不会实质性地改变感知油价冲击对通胀预期的有限传导。相比之下，感知的全球供给和需求冲击占主导地位，尤其是自大流行开始以来。在最初的八个月里，专业预测者总体上将大流行视为负面需求冲击，并降低了他们的短期通胀预期。在2021年初，专业人士迅速转变观点，在迅速增长且持续的供应链中断和劳动力约束中大幅提高了他们的通胀预期。

articles.title_en: The impact of supply chain disruptions on business expectations during the pandemic
articles.title_cn: 疫情期间供应链中断对企业预期的影响
articles.abstract_en: Utilizing the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta’s Business Inflation Expectations (BIE) survey, which has been continuously collecting subjective probability distributions over own-firm future unit costs since October 2011, we document two facts about firms’ marginal cost expectations and risk during the COVID-19 pandemic. First, in the early months of the pandemic, firms, on net, saw COVID-19 largely as a demand shock and lowered their one-year ahead expectations. However, as the pandemic wore on, firms’ one-year ahead unit cost expectations rose sharply alongside their views on supply chain and operating capacity disruptions. Second, the balance of unit cost risks shifted sharply over the course of the pandemic and by the end of 2022, upside risks had sharply outweighed perceived downside risks over the year ahead.
